title: Permissions, Disclosure, and Useful Output
description: Agent permissions after a false police tip, multimodal decision models, and AI disclosure in publishing; conversations on trust and goodput; evidence-based oversight, test reliability, and platform transitions.

coverage_gaps.Claude Blog: The configured claude.com/blog entry redirects to resources/articles. Rendered cards dated October 5, 6, and 8 were paired with embedded blogPost records; nine unique entries fall in the calendar discovery window. Two external Anthropic articles about Haiku 5.5 and cyber verification are counted separately under Anthropic, without duplication. List discovery does not establish review of every article body.
coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured AI blog redirects to Microsoft Source AI; static and rendered lists did not provide reliable publication dates. The configured feed returned HTTP 410. The AI topic feed returned ten entries, most recently September 10 at 13:08:37 UTC, with none in the window. A different all-site Source feed returned ten entries spanning October 6 at 22:41:27 to October 9 at 15:44:02 UTC, including seven AI or Surface candidates. This alternative feed does not establish equivalent coverage of the configured entry point.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The old blog’s latest visible date is September 23, 2025. The current rendered research page’s first screen includes September 3, 18, and 20, 2026, with no calendar-window items; pagination and filters were not exhausted. Static list data still carries older 2025 dates, and retrieval returned no entries. A supplementary Hugging Face organization check found one newly created model, Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo; creation is not announcement time. GitHub pushes are not a complete release list. Configuration was not changed.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The static page returned HTTP 200 and a roughly 127 KB response, with September 16, 2025 as its latest visible date and two news links lacking paired titles and publication dates. The rendered page supplied no dated news cards. These checks do not establish an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: API update entries were dated July 24 and 31, August 13 and 21, and September 10. Chinese and English news entries include September 29 and December 1, 2025, and April 24 and September 10, 2026; Harness materials include August 12 and September 1 and 4, 2026. A Next.js render timestamp was excluded from publication dates. No calendar-window entries were found in those lists. Among 44 organization repositories, two had window pushes (deepseek-harness and DeepJIT) and none were newly created. Release checks for those repositories found one window candidate. Pushes are not announcements, and other organizational releases remain incompletely covered.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The initial response was a roughly 2 KB shell. The rendered page displayed Step 5 Preview, Step 3.7 Flash, Step 3.5 Flash, and StepAudio 3, with a four-day countdown, compared with six days on October 8. No absolute publication dates or distinct news stream were established. No dated items were found; this does not mean no updates or a completed release.
coverage_gaps.European Commission Digital Strategy: List content blocks paired titles and dates for three calendar-window entries. They are not all AI-specific. List-level discovery is recorded separately from reading full article bodies, which was not completed.
coverage_gaps.UNESCO AI: Article data-date values most recently showed October 2 at 17:59:39 UTC, with older September 28 and 25 entries and none in the window. Future event dates were not treated as article publication dates. Full article bodies were not reviewed.
coverage_gaps.OECD.AI: The Wonk page’s ng-state data supplied sixteen deduplicated articles, most recently September 30 at 07:55 UTC in date_gmt, with none in the window. Other October dates on the site were not treated as article publication dates. Full bodies were not reviewed.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: Homepage announcements were dated February 13, March 23, and September 24, 2026. Venue entry points did not provide individual submission times, and new papers across venues were not traversed. Reachability does not establish an absence of new submissions.
coverage_gaps.36氪 AI 频道（逐篇核验原创与转载）: Thirty server-rendered items plus five load-more API pages supplied 180 entries, spanning October 9 at 21:40:05.260 to October 1 at 09:00:22.486 Beijing time and crossing the discovery-window start. Of 155 window entries, article-level timestamps, sourceType, userType, bylines, and source attributions identified 151 contributions and four originals. This was attribution checking, not full-body review of every article. Complete list traversal does not establish complete original-text review.
coverage_gaps.Ars Technica: The first AI list page supplied 36 time elements, spanning October 9 at 15:43:50 to September 28 at 07:00:09 (UTC−4), crossing the discovery-window start. Eight entries fall in the window. Their bodies were not read, and original versus syndicated FT or WIRED attribution was not fully verified.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review: The rendered page exposed twelve links with URL dates from October 9 back to January 12. The official topic feed’s ten entries spanned October 9 at 09:00 UTC to October 2 at 08:00 UTC, with four in the window. Additional URL-date candidates supplied no further paired window titles. Four entries were discovered; full bodies were not reviewed.
